title: Sensa At-Home Inflammation (CRP) Saliva Test Kit, 1 Test
description: Contains 1 at-home test. Perfect for trying Sensa. Sensa is a simple at-home saliva wellness kit that measures C-reactive protein (CRP), a key marker of inflammation, in about 15 minutes. Spit into the Sensa device, wait for the color change, then scan it with the free Sensa app to see your wellness score and what it means. No needles, no blood draw, no clinic visit, no lab wait. Each kit includes one at-home saliva test, instant results in the app, and personalized wellness insights with app access for tracking over time. Free shipping on every order. One-time purchase, no subscription. Sensa is a wellness tool, not a diagnosis and not a replacement for medical care. Incubated at Harvard Innovation Labs.
